title: Notification regarding establishment of the Special Court Manipur for NIA cases at Thoubal Court complex, The High Court of Manipur is pleased to recommend the following person for appointment as Driver .

HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 6th June, 2026
No. HCM/TP-SC/20 l 7-Estt-11/ Consequent to the establishment of the
Special Court Manipur for NIA cases at Thoubal Court Complex vide order No. 4/40/202 l-
Judl/L/e-file No. Judl-303/7/2022-SEC-LAW-Part(l) dated 3rd December, 2025 issued by the
Law & Legislative Affairs Department, Government of Manipur, the High Court of Manipur,
as an interim measure, is pleased to recommend the following person for appointment as Driver
on daily wages basis (@Rs. 4401- per day or the rate notified by the State Government of
Manipur from time to time), till the post is filled on regular basis:
1 Naobi Chabungbam Driver
Dail e Basis
District & Sessions Judge,
Thoubal
He is to report on or before 11 th June, 2026 during office hour.
The expenditure is de bitable from the relevant Head of Account of the Office of the District &
Sessions Court, Thoubal.
The aforesaid engagement is purely temporary in nature, and the incumbent shall not claim
regularisation or absorption into service on the basis of such engagement.
Endt. No. HCM/TP-SC/2017-Estt-11/ { ~ 68'0 -CfS'
